_comment: Settings of the session-memory hooks (decision 353): hooks/session_context.py, hooks/precompact_snapshot.py, recall.py build --settled, decisions_applied.py and supervisor_events.py. Every field is required and validated by memory_hooks_config.py; a missing or invalid field switches off only the block that needs it, with a visible 'not configured' line. total_inject_chars is at most 10000, the documented cap of the harness for hook context; inbox_max_chars at most 9000.
